This provider receives the encrypted backup and filename and may sync them. Saving verifies the exact ciphertext by reading it back. It does not prove cloud durability, a separate safe copy, or a tested restoration. For a new identity, its temporary key is saved locally only after that verification succeeds.

Enter the selected backup’s passphrase to validate and import its identity using your saved Allow always permission. Its integrity, certificate and key are checked first. Existing legacy or different identities cannot be replaced. The latest release remains unknown after import until you declare the version floor.
